entry.title: feat(melious): add Clef and Clef Flash decision models (#10552)
entry.content:
feat(melious): add Clef and Clef Flash decision models (#10552)

* feat(melious): add Clef and Clef Flash decision models

Melious serves Cloudflare's two open-weight decision models on
POST /v1/systemone, not chat completions. Neither had lab metadata in
the catalog, so add complete Cloudflare lab entries for Clef and
Clef Flash, plus override-only Melious entries.

Costs are Melious's list prices for input tokens -- EUR 0.20 for Clef
and EUR 0.03 for Clef Flash per 1M tokens -- converted at 1.1225
USD/EUR (ECB euro reference rate, 2026-10-19). Decision models bill
input only, so output is 0.

Melious caps both at 16,384 tokens and rejects images, so its entries
narrow the lab modalities to text and set attachment false. Reasoning
is always off with no caller control, hence no reasoning_options.
Cloudflare's weights are Apache-2.0 and support image and video input;
Clef Flash weights were trained for up to 256K tokens.

Sources:
- https://melious.ai/hub/models/clef
- https://melious.ai/hub/models/clef-flash
- https://melious.ai/docs/reference/systemone
- https://blog.cloudflare.com/clef-decision-models/
- https://blog.cloudflare.com/clef-faster-cheaper-multimodal/
- https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef
- https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef-flash

* docs(cloudflare): cite Clef video input and Flash context sources

Record Cloudflare's exact wording for video input on both Clef models and for the 256K self-hosted context of Clef Flash, addressing the PR review notes.

* fix(cloudflare): align Clef lab metadata with decision peers

Drop video from the lab modality lists to match the same-model Workers AI and OpenRouter entries, and mark both models as structured output because System One returns typed probabilities. Keep temperature false: the System One request exposes no sampling parameter, unlike the stale first-party Workers AI entries.

* fix(cloudflare): follow first-party temperature, override on Melious

Cloudflare's first-party Workers AI entries set temperature = true for Clef and Clef Flash, so keep that as the lab fact. Melious's System One endpoint has no temperature parameter, so its entries override it to false.

entry.title: feat(v2): migrate Vercel AI Gateway provider files to schema 2 (#10557)
entry.content:
feat(v2): migrate Vercel AI Gateway provider files to schema 2 (#10557)

* fix(v2): refuse to migrate provider files whose attachment disagrees with their modalities

* feat(v2): migrate Vercel AI Gateway provider files to schema 2 (mechanical)

* test(sync): Vercel base_model files keep exact MIME modalities and leave model facts to the lab

* fix(vercel): store mercury-2 cache read as 0.025 (what sync writes under v2's exact comparison)

* fix(vercel): base_model files inherit knowledge from the lab

o3-pro, gpt-3.5-turbo, glm-4.5 and glm-4.5v restated a knowledge cutoff that
disagrees with their lab files; the lab is the source of truth for model facts.

* fix(vercel): derive attachment from modalities on 14 models and migrate them to schema 2

Vercel's /v1/models lists text-only input for glm-5.1, mimo-v2.5-pro, qwen3.7-max
and minimax-m2.7(-highspeed) (attachment was true), and image input for
gemini-3-pro-image, gemini-2.5-flash-image, d1, muse-spark-1.1,
qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b, interfaze-beta, seed-1.6, seed-1.8 and mistral-medium-3.5
(attachment was false). v2 derives attachment from modalities.

* refactor(vercel): link 40 standalone files for lab-built models to their lab files

The files now use base_model and keep only Vercel deltas (display name,
description, limits, cost, reasoning controls, modalities where Vercel differs).
Model facts (family, release_date, last_updated, knowledge, open_weights)
inherit from the lab.

* feat(vercel): exact MIME modalities from the lab where Vercel narrows a model's inputs

* feat(vercel): exact MIME modalities from upstream and AI Gateway docs for the remaining generic entries

Each changed file cites its source in the leading comment. 7 keep a generic
image input because no official source lists formats (Callstack Apex, Elorian
Glimpse, Interfaze, Sakana Fugu x2, Inkling x2).

* feat(vercel): mid-conversation flags from live @ai-sdk/gateway probes

* fix(inference-net): Schematron V2 release date from Inference.net's launch post (2026-04-16)

The lab files carried OpenRouter's listing date (2026-09-12). Source:
https://inference.net/blog/schematron-v2 (published 2026-04-16).
